title: Security Engineer Junior - GRC
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🛡️ The role Most GRC roles are about keeping auditors happy. This one is about earning our members' trust: every day, they share their diagnoses, their claims and their care with us. You'll join Alan's security team to help run our compliance and risk work across ISO 27001, HDS and DORA, across a growing number of countries and regulators. We just earned our HDS certification, and there's much more to build, including how we govern AI across our products: assessing AI risks, setting the controls, and keeping up with the AI Act. You'll learn alongside experienced security engineers, with a dedicated coach from day one. You'll take on real ownership early, and your scope grows as we scale from 1M to many millions of members. And you'll learn how we work at Alan: teams own their risks and controls, we automate wherever we can, and we focus on real outcomes, not paperwork. 🚀 What you'll do Keep our certifications on track. You run the day-to-day of the ISO 27001 and HDS audit cycles: collecting evidence, preparing internal audits, and following up on corrective actions until they're closed. Turn regulations into practical actions. With Legal and the DPO, you help translate requirements like DORA, HDS, and GDPR into clear tasks for the teams, and track that they get done. Learn the health sector rules. You build your knowledge of health-specific frameworks (ANS, HDS) and help apply them to how we handle health data. Contribute to risk management. You help build and update our risk mapping, including AI risks, and follow up on the treatment plans with the teams who own them. Support the teams who own the controls. You keep the controls framework up to date, answer teams' questions, and help explain security clearly to every stakeholder, from engineers to managers. Support incident governance. You help classify and document incidents, keep Business continuity and Disaster recovery plans up to date, and prepare inputs for DORA incident reports. Automate what slows us down. You spot repetitive compliance tasks and automate them with scripts, tools or AI. 🏗️ What you'll help build One compliance backbone: A single control system for several regulators in several countries, so Alan can scale without rebuilding compliance each time. An automated evidence engine: evidence collected straight from engineering systems with scripts and AI, so audits run continuously instead of as a quarterly rush. You'll work closely with Legal, the DPO, Internal Audit and Risk, and day to day with engineering and operations teams. ⭐ What we're looking for You want to do the work yourself and grow with it: a permanent, hands-on role where you build things for the long run. 2+ years in security, GRC or compliance (an audit background is fine if you want to move into building). You've played a key part in a certification or audit cycle (ISO 27001, HDS, SOC 2 or similar). You're curious about how things work technically, and you've automated at least one manual task (a script, a tool, an AI workflow). You're fluent in French and English, and comfortable presenting in both. You learn fast, ask for feedback, and go into the details when it matters. 🌍 How we work Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain. Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility. 🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. You want to know more about Alan? 🙌 Perks & Benefits : Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 🤘 A strong culture : People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial (f/m/d)
description: About Cosuno Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in. Your mission As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who . What you will achieve in your first 12 months You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract. You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies. You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use. You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts. You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire. What the job really looks like A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you. You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast. There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire. You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to. What you bring At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives. A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling. Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked. Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch. Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers. Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters. Fluent German and English, written and spoken. Nice to have Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha. You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach. Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries. What we offer Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period. AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools. Learning budget for your professional development. Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year. Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours. A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events. Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company. Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks) Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video. Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video. Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office. References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles. Offer. From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks. Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know. title: Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the Platform Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be In the Platform Engineering team, you will build the next generation of the internal developer platform behind Spread Group's core services - a cloud-native platform on AWS, designed from the ground up. We see our platform as a product and our developers as our customers. This is a greenfield build with real design freedom: you shape the architecture, the golden paths and the self-service capabilities - not just keep existing systems running. Your platform will serve roughly 175 services from 13 product teams in our European and North American regions. Today they run on more than a dozen Kubernetes clusters with around 280 nodes and 4,000 running pods - migrating them step by step onto the new platform while everything keeps running is a core part of the mission. What You´ll Do Build the next-generation cloud-native platform on AWS - you own the architecture and design decisions from day one Design and build platform services, APIs and self-service capabilities that let teams build, deploy and operate their core services end-to-end Provide "golden paths": standardized templates, pipelines and building blocks that get teams to production quickly and safely Build and evolve the AWS cloud infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code, including Kubernetes and managed services Keep the platform secure, reliable and cost-efficient Work closely with development teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience Maintain the existing on-premises infrastructure and Kubernetes landscape - keeping all services reliably running while the migration to AWS is underway Guide the migration of roughly 175 existing services onto the new platform What You´ll Bring Several years of professional experience (mid-level to senior) in software engineering, ideally in platform engineering, SRE or DevOps - a computer science degree is welcome but not required Solid experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, Linux and containers Strong software engineering skills - you write production-grade code in a language such as Go, Python or TypeScript, building platform services and APIs, not just infrastructure scripts Experience designing REST APIs Solid Git skills and knowledge of platform services such as CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI) and observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) A product mindset - you see developers as the customers of your work Good communication skills in English Nice to Have Experience with GitOps (e.g., Argo CD) and secrets management (e.g., Vault) Experience with internal developer portals (e.g., Backstage) Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Kafka) Why Should You Join Us Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another. Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company. Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change. The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together. title: Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Social (m/f/d)
description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role overview As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved. Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth. Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required. Core responsibilities Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets. Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data. Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams. Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms. Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase. Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps. Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved. Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement. Requirements Background & Experience At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets. Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform. A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making. Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals. Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms. Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent. Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics. Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products. Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools. Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success. Why Join Us? Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story. Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale. Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company. Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team. Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location). Ready to Move the Needle? If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application. title: Partnerships Manager, Ecosystem
description: PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER, ECOSYSTEM ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform built for developers. We provide a complete backend solution — Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search — all deeply integrated and designed to scale. Millions of developers build on Supabase. We're remote-first, async-native, and we move fast. ABOUT THE ROLE We're in the early days of building our partner marketplace program, and this role is foundational to it. You'll help lay the groundwork for what this program becomes — starting by owning two critical pieces: deep account management for our top marketplace and referral partners, and vetting the intake of new partnership requests. You'll take a focused set of high-priority partners and go deep — building the co-marketing and co-sell motion that drives real user growth — while also serving as the first filter for new partner opportunities coming into the pipeline. What you'll do Partner Account Management - Develop and execute co-marketing and co-sell strategies with each partner to drive user growth - Own day-to-day relationship management for a focused portfolio of top marketplace and referral partners - Report on partner performance and progress — adoption, attribution, revenue impact — to internal stakeholders - Coordinate integration support and ensure partners have what they need to succeed post-signature Partner Intake & Routing - Vet incoming partnership requests and evaluate fit against our partnership criteria - Ensure new partners are routed and bucketed correctly across the right internal programs - Own partner onboarding — getting new partners set up and moving smoothly from signed agreement to active partner - Flag high-potential opportunities for further evaluation or escalation Who you are - 5-10 years of experience in Partnerships, referral marketing, or channel sales - Experience helping build a marketplace from 0 to 1 - Domain expertise spanning PLG motions, integrations, marketplace ecosystems, and devtools/database companies — you understand how developers evaluate and adopt infrastructure tooling, and you've seen how partner programs operate from the inside - Track record of driving co-marketing and co-sell campaigns that delivered measurable results, with a solid grasp of attribution - Fluent working across modern tool stacks — Notion, Linear, Slack, Claude, and similar systems — as part of your daily workflow Nice to have - Prior experience at an early-stage startup - Hands-on experience building with Supabase or AI-powered tools (Lovable, Bolt, Figma, v0, etc.) We Offer - 100% remote, no location-based salary adjustments - Autonomous work environment - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental — 100% for employees, 80% for dependents - Tech Allowance + Annual Education Allowance - Annual company off-sites WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Financial Controller | AI Enabled Finance Operations

title: Senior Security Engineer - Remote
description: About Us Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services. Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot , Polkadot SDK , and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications. About the Team Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design. About the Role As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols. Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools. Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation. Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues. Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle. Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software. Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security. What We're Looking For Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts. Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development. Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports. Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection). title: Head of Communications (New Media)
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Traditional PR is fading — we go directly to our audience. This role brings together what used to be two separate seats, communications and social media, into one mid-to-senior, hands-on role: owning Supabase's voice in the channels where developers actually pay attention, and building our founders' presence in them. "New media" here means modern and direct, not traditional press — we care far more about getting our founders onto the right podcasts and YouTube channels than landing a New York Times placement. It's part comms, part social operator, with a sharper edge than a typical polite PR hire: someone willing to put an opinion out there and push a little rather than always play it safe. But it's not just a social media job either — this person also needs the poise and technical credibility to lead comms through genuinely high-stakes moments, like a major incident, where reporters, investors, and customers all need a calm, credible, technically fluent voice at the same time. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Make sure we're part of the current conversation and are going directly to our audience — new media over old-world press - Own and execute our new media strategy - Run and grow Supabase's X + LinkedIn accounts, hands on keyboard - Help build the accounts of our founders and team — including ghostwriting in their voice - Explore and exploit unconventional channels and formats - Book our cofounders on the most known shows, podcasts, and YouTube channels in our space - Work directly with DevRel and the PMM team on launches and Select - Manage comms around incidents, funding, and other high-stakes moments — crisis comms handled with poise and technical credibility (this is key) YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Excellent writer with a distinctive voice — equally strong posting as yourself and ghostwriting for others - Track record of growing accounts, ideally for a technical audience - Unconventional thinker — willing to put an opinion out there and push a little, with the judgment to know when - Seasoned enough for the serious moments — incidents, funding, press — calm, credible, and technically fluent - High agency — you're probably already doing a version of this somewhere scrappier WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Director of Lifecycle Marketing
description: About Upstart At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. The Team: Upstart's Lifecycle Marketing team is responsible for driving engagement and growth across the customer lifecycle for every Upstart product. The team develops and executes lifecycle strategies that help customers discover, adopt, and deepen their relationship with Upstart through personalized, data-driven experiences across multiple owned channels. As the Director of Lifecycle Marketing, you will lead the strategy, performance, and evolution of Lifecycle Marketing across Upstart's growing product portfolio. You'll oversee an experienced team of marketing leaders, shape the long-term roadmap for the channel, and partner closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Product Marketing, and Growth teams to drive meaningful business outcomes. How you’ll make an impact Define and execute the long-term Lifecycle Marketing strategy across Upstart's products and customer journeys. Lead and develop a high-performing team of lifecycle marketing leaders, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and opportunities for growth. Own revenue and performance goals for Lifecycle Marketing, using experimentation, optimization, and automation to improve customer engagement and business results. Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing teams to prioritize initiatives and deliver customer experiences across email, push, SMS, in-app messaging, and emerging channels. Establish scalable lifecycle infrastructure, governance, and measurement frameworks that support a growing portfolio of products and more complex customer journeys. Champion thoughtful adoption of AI and automation to improve lifecycle operations, accelerate experimentation, and increase team productivity while maintaining high quality standards. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience in B2C Lifecycle Marketing. 5+ years of direct people management experience, including experience leading managers. 4+ years of hands-on experience building and operating enterprise marketing automation platforms. Experience owning revenue-driven Lifecycle Marketing programs with accountability for performance targets, experimentation, and measurable business growth. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of enterprise marketing automation platforms such as Iterable. Experience building lifecycle marketing programs for complex, regulated, or high-consideration customer journeys. Experience using customer data platforms (CDPs) to create and activate customer audiences. Ability to leverage AI tools to improve experimentation, workflow efficiency, campaign development, and marketing decision-making. Skill in translating long-term business strategy into scalable lifecycle programs while influencing cross-functional stakeholders. Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. Position Overview: Dandy is looking for an Account Manager to join the growing team and delight our customers: dentists across the country. New customers will be transitioned directly from sales to you, and you will quickly build your portfolio to 200+ accounts. Our Multi Location segment serves parent accounts that have more than 1 location. As the owner of your book of business, your primary focus will be on driving revenue per practice (ARPP) by proactively fostering strong customer relationships, activating new user (doctor) growth, and expanding into new locations. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Training, and Customer Support to drive customer satisfaction and ultimately customer retention. Key Responsibilities Book Management Own a portfolio of multi-location accounts and drive NRR through proactive planning and engagement . Analyze account performance and customer feedback to build strategic engagement plans tailored to each parent organization. Use a mix of service and commercial skills to guide practices through critical moments in the Dandy journey. Leverage dashboards and data triggers to prioritize outreach and identify expansion or renewal opportunities across sites. Revenue Growth Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities within each parent account. Drive activation of additional doctors and scanners within existing practices. Lead expansion into new practice locations , ensuring consistent onboarding and alignment with parent-level goals. Client Relationship Management Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with executives, doctors, and/or practice managers across all locations. Serve as a strategic consultant , offering tailored solutions and guidance to align with customer objectives. Negotiate contract terms with key stakeholders and implement churn-reduction strategies. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, CX, Training, Ops and Marketing to ensure a unified customer experience across locations. Clinical Knowledge Develop a deep understanding of dental practice operations and the competitive digital dentistry landscape . Communicate confidently in the “language” of clinicians to provide consultative problem-solving and drive adoption. Stay informed on product updates, scanner capabilities, and market trends to add strategic value in every interaction. Continuous Improvement Experiment with new tactics, talk tracks, and engagement models to improve retention and expansion. Collaborate across teams to ensure customers receive timely, consistent support during every stage of their journey. Capture and share Voice of Customer insights to influence product and operational enhancements. Contribute to playbook development that scales successful multi-location engagement strategies company-wide. Automation & System Integration : Accelerate automation and technology integrations across Stripe, NetSuite, Brex, and our proprietary internal operating platform, Playbook OS. Data Analysis & Insight Generation : Build advanced data capabilities to deliver actionable financial insights that empower department heads. Team Leadership & Organizational Scaling: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing finance team capable of supporting rapid company growth. Accounting & Compliance: GAAP compliance, external audit management, tax strategy, and multi-entity/subsidiary consolidation. Treasury & Cash Management: Working capital optimization, free cash flow (FCF) forecasting, and cash buffer governance. Exit / M&A Readiness: Data room preparation, quality of earnings (QoE) readiness, and board/investor reporting. Systems Mastery: Proven track record administering and integrating NetSuite, high-volume payment processors (Stripe), and spend management platforms (Brex). Advanced SQL or BI dashboarding experience is a strong plus. Strategic & Operational Range : Ability to zoom out for board-level scenario modeling and zoom in to troubleshoot complex multi-entity reconciliations or ERP data flows. Executive Presence & Influence: A collaborative coach who translates complex financial data into clear operational narratives for non-finance leaders Compensation Additional Information Our Core Values: Playbook's culture is based on a shared respect for our lived values HERE. Fit with our values is a critical component of our hiring process, and you and all of our colleagues are expected to live our core values in interactions with team members, customers, and stakeholders. Our Commitment To You: Playbook is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We know the more inclusive we are, the greater our impact will be! title: Senior Revenue Accountant
description: About Our Company: Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. title: (765) Data Analyst (Healthcare Fraud)
description: Company Summary Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future. Position Description: Arlo Solutions is supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Integrity and Compliance (OIC) in standing up and running the VHA Fraud Rapid Response Center ("VA War Room"). The War Room protects Veterans and taxpayer dollars through data analytics, fraud risk assessment and fast administrative action, in line with Executive Orders 14395 and 14243. The Data Analyst (Healthcare Fraud) is Essential Personnel on the fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) analytics team. Working under the Analytics and Technology Program Director and the Senior Data Analyst, this person uses VA's Palantir analytics and workflow platform to analyze VHA claims, enrollment and exclusion data. The analyst builds and tests business rules that detect potential fraud and overpayments, and surfaces anomalies and prioritized leads for OIC review. This includes supporting the Provider 360 view of community care providers, anomaly detection and network analysis to find coordinated billing schemes. The role is advisory and analytical. All final decisions stay with Government personnel. Location: Remote with On-Site Requirements Clearance: Public Trust Responsibilities and/or Success Factors: FWA Rule & Algorithm Development: Write, test and document business rules and algorithm logic mapped to FWA schemes. Support provider risk-scoring and case-prioritization criteria. Platform Development: Support configuration, code development and deployment on VA's Palantir platform, including data pipelines and system integration. Provider 360 & Anomaly Detection: Help combine claims, enrollment and exclusion data into a single Provider 360 view. Support anomaly detection and network analysis. Weekly Analytic Runs: Run the weekly analytics that feed War Room decision packages and the recurring prioritized lead lists. Data Extraction & Analysis: Extract, clean and analyze federal healthcare data for FWA identification. Support claim review workpapers. Quality Assurance & Back-Testing: Back-test rules, track rule precision and support QA and corrective action plans. The QASP targets at least 65% positive predictive value in month one and 70% by Day 60. Benchmarking: Support federal benchmarking and alignment of VHA data analysis with CMS data and methods. Dashboards & Reporting: Build dashboards, visualizations and data for quarterly fraud trend and improper payment reduction reports, risk governance reporting and leadership briefings. Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Document rule specifications, acceptance criteria and analytic methods. Train VA staff to run War Room analytics on their own. Minimum Qualifications Including Certificates: Must be legally eligible to work in the United States Able to pass a Tier 2 / Moderate Background Investigation (MBI) and get a VA PIV card Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science or a related field (such as data science, statistics or health informatics) 2-5 years of federal healthcare data analytics experience, such as with Medicare, Medicaid or VHA data Experience writing healthcare data analytics business rules Strong coding skills in SQL and Python (or PySpark/R) Proficiency with analytics platforms, including data pipelines, transformations and dashboards Working knowledge of healthcare claims data, such as claim types, CPT/HCPCS and ICD-10 codes, NPIs and provider and beneficiary data Able to handle PHI and sensitive information under HIPAA and VA privacy requirements, and to complete the required VA TMS trainings Desired Qualifications: Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry or Gotham Healthcare FWA or payment integrity analytics experience, such as detecting upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, impossible days or excluded providers Experience with VA Community Care data, the CMS Integrated Data Repository (IDR), or the OIG LEIE and SAM exclusion lists Anomaly detection, machine learning or network/link analysis experience Rule back-testing and precision measurement experience (PPV, false-positive analysis) Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar visualization tools Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) or a data or analytics certification AAP Statement We are proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, we evaluate qualified candidates in full consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, and any other protected status.

title: Global Pricing Specialist
description: Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es Why join us? Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success. Job Description This role is remote within Brazil Your main project is the listing-based pricing rollout across markets. You'll diagnose what's working, propose fixes, get local and global teams on board, and roll out to new countries with clear targets and a steady weekly cadence. You'll also shape how the model evolves for next year. You'll own the ARPU (average revenue per user) target for the segment. Alongside the main project, you'll: Move the ARPU target through specific pricing moves: tighter discount discipline, package mix shifts, price resets by market. Dig into anomalies fast. Spot pricing opportunities across the marketplace that no one's looking at, and make the case for them. Own the segment's pricing recommendations to GTM leadership: propose the moves, defend the trade-offs with data, turn decisions into rollout plans. Drive alignment across sales, local commercial, and global teams on contested pricing calls, without formal authority. Generate optimization hypotheses grounded in data. Design and run behavioral experiments to validate pricing moves before scaling them. Adjust and follow up on budget assumptions as we learn from the market. Maintain country price lists in our internal systems. Qualifications What will help you thrive? 5+ years in pricing, ideally SaaS or marketplace Direct experience working with GTM or sales leaders on pricing decisions Thorough with data. You back conclusions with numbers. Comfort with ambiguity: you know when to stop analyzing and start testing Ability to explain complex numbers simply SQL good enough to pull your own data Strong Google Sheets skills Professional English, comfortable in meetings and writing (B2 or above) Degree in economics, math, business, or similar What to Expect from Our Hiring Process We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): 1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. 2️⃣ TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment). 3️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. 4️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Douglas Giehl (Global Pricing Director) and your potential manager in this role . Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. 5️⃣ References & Offer! Why You’ll Love It Here Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. ⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. What We Believe In At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do: Focus on results – we're here to make an impact. Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes. ✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity. Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust. Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job. Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say! _________________________________________________________________________ We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Creative (Illustrator)
description: Superside is looking for an Illustrator with a strong command of Generative AI to create exceptional work for some of the world’s leading brands. You’ll combine deep illustrative craft with AI-enhanced workflows to develop compelling visuals across campaigns, branding, editorial content, and digital experiences. Illustration is your core discipline. You bring strong visual storytelling skills, can work within established brand systems, and know how to use AI to expand creative possibilities while maintaining quality and consistency. What you'll do Create original illustrations across branding, campaigns, editorial content, social media, and digital experiences. Develop character-driven narratives, visual storytelling systems, and concept-led illustration work. Work within existing brand and illustration systems, matching established styles with consistency and accuracy. Use Generative AI tools to accelerate concept development, visual exploration, and illustration production. Integrate AI-generated assets into projects while maintaining strong artistic direction and brand integrity. Experiment with emerging AI workflows and share learnings with the broader creative team. Partner with creatives, project managers, and customers to translate briefs into polished visual outcomes. Connect illustration decisions to broader brand, campaign, and storytelling goals. Iterate quickly based on feedback while maintaining a high standard of craft. Manage multiple projects while balancing independent ownership and cross-functional collaboration. What you’ll bring 5+ years of professional illustration experience with a portfolio showcasing strong conceptual and narrative work. Excellent drawing fundamentals, including anatomy, composition, perspective, form, and visual storytelling. Proven ability to work within established brand systems and illustration guidelines. Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and related illustration tools. Experience using Generative AI tools as part of a professional creative workflow. Ability to create consistent illustration systems, character libraries, and scalable visual assets. Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality execution. Excellent English communication skills and ability to collaborate across distributed teams. Collaborative mindset with openness to feedback, iteration, and experimentation. Curiosity for emerging technologies and how they can enhance illustration workflows. Compensation Additional Information Why Join us? Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are. Remote-first. Customer-led. Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones. Global team, local impact. Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands. High performance, low ego. Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration. Impact meets opportunity. We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here. Grow fast. Lead well. You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry. About Superside Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones. Learn more at superside.com Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We’re an equal-opportunity company. title: AI Enablement and Learning Specialist
description: Superside is reinventing how its people learn, and we're looking for someone to help bring that vision to life in practical, AI-powered ways. As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you'll join the Learning Enablement and Transformation team. You'll work closely with the person leading our learning strategy, turning goals and ideas into working solutions: Claude-supported resources, automated workflows, and well-organized knowledge that people can actually find and use. You'll also keep the systems and knowledge behind our learning programs in good order, so everything runs smoothly with little manual effort. This isn't a traditional L&D role. If you love working with information, enjoy building with AI and automation tools, and care about how people learn, you'll feel at home here. You'll work independently, from ideas and open problems rather than step-by-step briefs, in a fully remote, ambitious, async-first team. What you'll do Research practical, AI-powered ways to deliver on our learning goals, and recommend what's worth implementing. Prototype Claude-supported learning resources and automations, and turn the best ones into working solutions. Build and launch new learning initiatives, from first idea to something people use. Run and improve async onboarding, so new joiners get a smooth, mostly automated experience. Organize and maintain our learning knowledge, so it's easy to find, trust and keep up to date. Automate enrolments, reminders, tracking and reporting across our learning systems. Look after our learning systems and tools such as Sana LMS, Notion, Claude so they stay reliable and easy to use. Create learning content when needed, such as short modules, guides and resources. Work with stakeholders across the company to understand their learning needs and turn them into practical solutions. What you'll need to succeed Strong experience organizing and managing knowledge: structuring information, keeping it current, and making it easy to use. Hands-on experience building with AI, and a real curiosity about what's possible next. Experience with workflow automation tools and a comfort with the technical side of things. A systems mindset: you see how the pieces connect, and you follow through until it works. Comfort solving problems from ambiguity, turning an idea or a rough goal into a clear plan. A people-first approach: you think about the learner and their experience, not just the tool. Experience in learning and development, HR, enablement, or a related field is a plus, though it's not the centre of the role. Experience with learning platforms (such as an LMS) is a plus. Ability to create clear, simple learning content and communications. Proactive and independent: you don't wait for step-by-step instructions. Great written communication in English, and comfort working async in a remote team. Compensation Additional Information Why Join us? title: Backend Engineer, Create: Source Code Experience (Ruby)
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Source Code Experience team within GitLab's Create stage. You'll help make everyday source code workflows clear, reliable, and efficient for people working across GitLab projects. As artificial intelligence agents increasingly write and manage code alongside people, you'll build backend capabilities and interfaces that support trustworthy collaboration between people and agents. You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL to improve critical source code experiences across GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. The Source Code group is responsible for the backend and frontend aspects of the product categories within Source Code. With support from experienced team members, you'll help maintain high reliability through performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and other Source Code teams to deliver reliable and performant systems. Learn more about the Create:Source Code teams in the GitLab Handbook. What you’ll do Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL. Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system. Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows. Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome. Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output. Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews. Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency. Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others. What you’ll bring Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL. An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices. Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems. Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes. Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo. Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment. The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed. About the team We work on a complex product area that serves GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. You'll work closely with Code Review, Gitaly, and other Source Code teams. We welcome candidates with different levels and types of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiting team to assess your application. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. title: Billing SME - Product
description: Elation is building the technology platform that powers the new era of primary care. Our Clinical-First® EHR is beloved by physicians and is enabling the transition to value-based care. We're a mission-driven team committed to empowering independent primary care physicians and improving the quality of care for patients. We're looking for a Billing SME to join Elation's Billing Team’s and accelerate our AI-powered billing capabilities. As AI takes on more of the revenue cycle, this role will serve as the billing expert who ensures our AI features deliver accurate, trustworthy billing outcomes that practices can rely on. You'll be the connective tissue between our product team and the real world of primary care billing — bringing hands-on RCM expertise to help us build AI that billing professionals actually trust. Why This Role Exists Accelerate Agentic Billing velocity. Your hands-on primary care coding and RCM expertise (e.g., AdvancedMD, Athena, or similar billing solutions) lets our team iterate on AI billing features with fast, credible domain feedback instead of waiting on live-customer validation for every coding or claims decision. Manage billing risk and trust as AI takes on more of the revenue cycle. Coding and billing correctness carries real financial and compliance consequences — denials, CPT/ICD accuracy, payer rules. As AI authorship of billing decisions grows, you'll evaluate and safeguard accuracy and practice trust. You're the billing analog to the clinical-safety role our Clinical SMEs play for clinical AI. What You'll Do User Zero Testing — Feedback & Insight Test new AI billing capabilities (coding suggestions, Auto-Queue, Worklist, ERA/payment posting) before wider release, evaluating them against real coding and billing judgment. You'll be the first eyes on every billing feature, providing the credible feedback that shapes the product. Front-line Context & Grounding Bring firsthand experience of how competitor and adjacent billing systems handle the same workflows, so our billing teams build with the broader RCM landscape in view — not just Elation's current implementation. Help us understand what "best in class" looks like. Billing Evaluation & Success Criteria Define what "correct" means for coding and billing outputs — a billing-specific subset of user success criteria — and pressure-test AI-generated billing outputs before they reach practices. Your judgment protects practices from billing mistakes. Design Partner Sit alongside Product Design as a billing co-designer, providing billing and coding context and success criteria directly into the design process. Help architect workflows for process excellence by providing a high-level view of industry standards and differentiators. Customer Partner & Key Contributor Support Work with Product to act as the connective tissue between both billing teams and: Customer and design-partner practices piloting Agentic Billing, translating their real billing language and pain points into product-usable input Internal key contributors — Enablement, Marketing, Sales, CSMs, Engagement Advisors, Support, other SMEs — who today escalate billing questions ad hoc and need a defined path to expertise What Success Looks Like Requirements: Billing and coding requirements for billing teams features carry your direct input — written into the requirements themselves, not layered on as post-hoc review Contributes to customer-facing and design groups: Work with Product and Design to execute discovery and design sessions with design-partner practices and cross-functional design reviews, on a standing cadence PM/PD-aligned: Your requirements and customer synthesis feed straight into product management's prioritization, design, and roadmap calls Standup presence: Show up regularly in CSM/Support stand-ups, so billing escalations get triaged directly rather than bouncing through ad hoc Slack DMs You'll Wear Two Hats Billing Co-Designer — Bring primary-care coding and RCM expertise into the design process the way Clinical SMEs bring clinical expertise: defining billing success criteria, front-line grounding, and user-zero testing. Customer & Cross-Functional Liaison — Be the person Engagement Advisors, Support, and other SMEs escalate billing questions to, and who works directly with customer and design-partner accounts to turn real billing language into input GPT/Thor can act on. What You'll Bring Required: 3+ years of hands-on primary care billing and coding experience in a physician practice setting Deep familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, and modifier rules for primary care Experience with practice management and billing systems (e.g., AdvancedMD, Athena, Kareo, or similar platforms) Working knowledge of commercial and government payer rules, denial management, and claims workflows Ability to translate billing domain knowledge into clear, actionable product feedback Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, and Customer Success teams Strong written and verbal communication skills Nice to Have: Experience with EHR workflows and how billing intersects with clinical documentation Familiarity with value-based care billing models (MSSP, CPC+, direct contracting) Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or similar certification Experience in a SaaS, product, or technology-forward healthcare company Previous involvement in user testing, product feedback, or design partnership roles What This Role Is Not Not a roadmap or prioritization owner — Billing teams retain those decisions Not a gate that blocks releases — You provide feedback to teams, not directives Not a substitute for user research — You support and accelerate it, you don't replace it Salary: $ Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. title: Case Resolution Engineer
description: Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers. We're hiring Support Engineers to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but trace them back to the line of product code causing them, ship the fix that resolves the customer's problem immediately, and partner with senior engineers on the cases complex enough to need them. You might be the recent engineering grad who spent a summer at a busy front desk, in a popular restaurant, or on a support line because you like people as much as you like problems, and who's been quietly automating things nobody asked you to fix since your first CS class. Or, you might be the person who leads team projects, tinkers with the dashboards, automations, or workflows so automatically that colleagues assume you are an engineer even if you aren’t. If that sounds like you, this role turns that problem-solving instinct into your core responsibility. As a Support Engineer, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen. Role and Responsibilities Synthesize and share customer insights. Surface patterns from your cases in weekly and monthly reports, participate in Product and Engineering discussions with what you're learning, and mentor Support Team members on AI workflows, scripting, and SQL queries. Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter. Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations and scripts, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain. What success looks like in your first 6 months Delivered solutions that reduced case volume by 10% or eliminated recurring issue categories, with measurable customer impact (e.g., CSAT, reduction in case reopens) A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Support can run with You've picked up or sharpened a technical skill — SQL, Python, an API, a scripting language — specifically because a customer problem needed it, not because a course assigned it Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis Identified and closed gaps across internal and customer-facing documentation, improving accuracy and reducing repeat questions. Professional Qualifications 1–5+ years of experience in Engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation tinkering in any field — OR a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus real experience talking to people under pressure (support, hospitality, retail, service, resident advising) Comfortable enough with code to experiment : you've written scripts, touched an API, or built something in Python, SQL, or JavaScript — even if it was just for a class project , team project or yourself A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations, class or personal projects — with evidence of outcomes Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself Show us your work Along with your application, in a cover letter send us: 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — a work project, a personal build, or something from school or an internship — what you made, who it was for, why you needed to do it, and what changed.
