title: Head of Customer Growth
description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role We are looking for a Head of Customer Growth to build and lead the operating system that helps RevenueCat customers become better app businesses. This is broader than a traditional Customer Success role. It combines strategic account coverage, app-growth judgment, specialist advisory, customer education, product adoption, and scalable enablement. The goal is not to give every customer the same high-touch service. It is to identify where RevenueCat can create disproportionate value, deploy the right kind of help, and turn every successful customer intervention into knowledge that benefits the rest of the customer base. You will lead a multi-lane Customer Growth function spanning the CSM team, Growth Advisory, Growth Advocacy, and the emerging Customer Enablement function. The CSM Team Lead will own daily CSM execution. You will set the strategy, operating model, talent bar, investment plan, and measures of success for the function as a whole. For our highest-value customers, this means deep account context, growth diagnosis, stakeholder mapping, product-adoption strategy, technical-account coordination, and clear next-step ownership. For high-potential customers, it means identifying them early and providing the right help before revenue has fully materialized. For customers with specific growth bottlenecks, it means bringing in the right specialist. For the broader customer base, it means scalable education through Growth Advocates, lifecycle guidance, office hours, playbooks, templates, product nudges, and eventually dynamic next-best-action systems. Your job is to make Customer Growth one operating system rather than a collection of disconnected activities. Why we are hiring for this role now RevenueCat serves tiny indie apps, fast-growing startups, games, media companies, health and fitness apps, AI products, marketplaces, and some of the most sophisticated consumer app businesses in the world. The app market is top-heavy, so the human touch must be allocated deliberately. At the same time, a customer that is small today may become strategically important very quickly. Contract status and current revenue are necessary signals, but they are not sufficient. We already have many of the ingredients: CSMs, a CSM Team Lead role, Growth Advocates, Customer Growth Advisory specialists, Product, Support, Marketing, Sales, TAM, Data, and one of the richest datasets in app monetization. We need a leader who can turn those ingredients into a coherent function. What you will be responsible for Own Customer Growth strategy across the full customer base. Define how RevenueCat helps customers grow after they begin using the product, including named accounts, high-potential customers, specialist-assisted customers, scaled customers, and the long tail. Build segmentation and coverage. Use current value, future potential, adoption, intent, growth moments, risk, and strategic importance to decide who receives named CSM coverage, time-bound help, specialist advisory, scaled education, product-led guidance, or monitoring. Lead through the CSM Team Lead. Set the bar for customer context, account strategy, stakeholder management, growth diagnosis, adoption planning, commercial awareness, and follow-through. Develop the Team Lead and create a strong leadership bench rather than becoming the permanent CSM manager. Identify high-potential customers early. Work with Data, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support to find customers with meaningful future potential before revenue alone makes them obvious. Govern Growth Advisory. Define intake, qualification, expected impact, output quality, follow-through, and reuse. Specialists should be deployed against specific high-value problems rather than become general-purpose consulting capacity. Make Growth Advocacy a customer-education channel. Ensure Growth Advocates turn real customer learning into authoritative one-to-many education for existing customers and the broader app ecosystem. Build Customer Enablement and Scaled Growth. Create the roadmap for lifecycle programs, templates, office hours, documentation, automation, product nudges, and next-best-action guidance. Drive meaningful product adoption. Partner with Product and Product Marketing so customers adopt RevenueCat capabilities in ways that help them win, rather than merely increasing feature activity. Create clear cross-functional decision rights. Define how Customer Growth works with Sales, TAM, Support, Product, Marketing, and Data without turning CSMs into AEs, TAMs into a catch-all, or collaboration into meeting theater. Build the customer-insight loop. Repeated customer questions should become product improvements, enablement, playbooks, benchmarks, documentation, lifecycle programs, and market education. Own the function. Set metrics, operating cadences, headcount plans, budget, organization design, executive communication, and the talent bar across Customer Growth. What success looks like Within the first month Meet directly with at least 15 customers across different sizes, growth stages, product footprints, and monetization models—including high-value, high-potential, at-risk, and scaled customers. Take point on at least two live customer-growth situations. Work alongside the CSM, Advisory, TAM, Support, or Product partner to diagnose the problem, agree ownership, and move each customer to a concrete next milestone. Ship at least one no-regrets improvement to a broken handoff, account motion, Advisory route, or customer experience rather than waiting for a complete strategy. Establish a clear operating agreement with the CSM Team Lead and act on urgent customer, talent, or ownership issues. Build a working view of the team, coverage, high-potential misses, lane boundaries, and metrics—deep enough to make decisions, without allowing analysis to delay action. Within the first three months Act as executive sponsor for a small set of strategically important or high-potential customers and personally lead at least two customer-growth interventions through a measurable milestone. Put the first version of segmentation and coverage into production on real accounts, then revise it from evidence. Run decision-oriented account reviews and a working Growth Advisory intake and follow-through motion. Ship the first scaled education or Customer Enablement program based on a repeated customer need. Make the first material changes to ownership, operating cadence, or talent where the current model is not working. Establish a customer-insight loop that turns frontline evidence into owned Product, education, lifecycle, or process actions. Within the first six months Maintain direct customer contact every week and own selected executive relationships while leading the wider system through the CSM Team Lead and specialist leaders. Operate a functioning multi-lane Customer Growth model with clear owners, live handoffs, and visible outcomes across CSM, Growth Advisory, Growth Advocacy, and Customer Enablement. Have the CSM Team Lead independently owning daily CSM execution, coaching, and account quality. Demonstrate measurable results from customer interventions and show that repeated one-to-one work is becoming reusable Advisory output, education, enablement, or product insight. Have shipped multiple scaled programs and made concrete hiring or investment decisions for the function. Within the first twelve months RevenueCat has a trusted, actively used system for serving high-value, high-potential, specialist-assisted, and scaled customers. Customer Growth produces measurable improvement in customer outcomes, meaningful product adoption, account health, renewal readiness, expansion quality, and customer revenue outcomes. The Head remains directly connected to customers and is a trusted executive partner for selected strategic accounts. The best customer work consistently becomes reusable product, education, and market leverage. The function has a strong leadership bench and a record of shipping improvements without waiting for perfect information. What you will need to be successful Approximately 10 or more years in Customer Success, Customer Growth, strategic accounts, Growth Advisory, product growth, lifecycle, monetization, or an adjacent customer-facing function. Five or more years leading customer-facing teams, including managers, senior team leads, or specialist groups. Evidence of owning an entire function or multi-lane operating model, not only managing an individual CSM team. Experience building or materially rebuilding segmentation, coverage, strategic-account, adoption, health, advisory, or scaled-customer systems. Strong commercial judgment around NDR, renewal risk, expansion influence, customer value, and executive alignment. Credibility with mobile apps, app monetization, in-app purchases, paywalls, checkout, pricing and offers, lifecycle, retention, experimentation, analytics, or a closely adjacent domain. Enough product and technical fluency to lead around a developer-facing platform while preserving clear ownership for TAM, Support, and Engineering. Experience managing both generalists and specialists. Evidence of turning repeated one-to-one work into scalable systems. Strong written communication, directness, and remote-first operating habits. Evidence of hiring, coaching, performance management, and raising the leadership and talent bar. Ideally, you Have led CSMs and advisory, education, lifecycle, or enablement teams together. Have scaled a customer-facing function through a major company-growth stage. Have worked in a hybrid self-serve, product-led, and enterprise business. Have firsthand experience as an app operator, growth leader, founder, or consultant. Have built product-led or tech-touch Customer Success programs. Have helped productize or commercialize an advisory or professional-services capability. What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually Paid desk at a co-working space Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend Interviewing at RevenueCat Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. This role sits within Ironclad’s enterprise go-to-market motion, managing a hyper-focused named account list of Global 2000 enterprises where deal complexity, multi-thread, and strategic alignment are paramount. Global 2000 organizations often operate across multiple business units, geographies, and supplier ecosystems, with high volumes of commercial agreements, procurement contracts, sell-side terms, and compliance-heavy workflows. In this role, you’ll help enterprises connect contracting transformations to measurable business outcomes such as accelerated revenue, reduced risk, streamlined global procurement, and operational scale. You’ll orchestrate multi-stakeholder evaluations, partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Outcomes, partners, and sales leadership, and build compelling business cases that position Ironclad as a strategic platform decision. What We’re Looking For: 10+ years of closing sales experience in a similar capacity Experience selling SaaS in complex enterprise environments, including $1M ARR deals and/or sales into Fortune 2000 organizations Strong track record of creating and closing new business, with comfort generating your own pipeline and hunting into whitespace accounts Proven ability to run a hybrid enterprise sales motion, balancing virtual and on-site field cycles Master-level ability to navigate highly matrixed, multi-subsidiary global enterprises with complex buying centers and centralized IT/Procurement gates. Ability to engage multiple buying centers and tailor value to different stakeholders, from functional leaders to the C-suite Curiosity and genuine interest in Ironclad’s product, mission, and market Strong business acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to connect day-to-day customer pain to broader transformation goals Excellent communication skills and consistent follow-through with customers and internal partners Highly collaborative working style and willingness to contribute beyond your own deals Coachable, adaptable, and comfortable giving and receiving feedback CLM and/or CPQ experience preferred Comfortable traveling to customers; travel of 25%+ expected Why This Role? title: Analytics Engineer
description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. title: Account Executive, Mid Market (TOLA)
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Mississippi, Alabama. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. Minimum requirements for this role: 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue All candidates must be located in one of the following US states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Mississippi, Alabama. An ideal candidate has: Proven track record of consistent quota achievement Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes Experience with high-volume cold calling Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process SFDC familiarity The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed. Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual OTE Salary $152,000—$190,000 USD Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development
description: Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development Affiliate Marketing / MarTech — Acceleration Partners LOCATION This is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners, a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Applicants can be based in the US, UK, Germany. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a hunter to drive new client acquisition for our Affiliate Marketing & Influencer Services. This is a new business development role built for someone who thrives on opening doors: sourcing opportunities, building relationships with enterprise decision-makers, and running a deal from first contact through close. Our marketing team generates inbound leads and our sales support team provides collateral and financial modeling, but the right candidate won't wait for leads to come to them. This role is built around a team-based selling model. You bring the opportunity in the door, qualify it, and manage the relationship and the process; our strategy and account management teams build the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and lead the pitch delivery. You're the connective tissue between the prospect and our experts, and the role suits driven, relationship-first sellers who want to sell alongside a strong internal team rather than carry the full strategic load alone. TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES New Business Development: Proactively source and build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and strategic networking, in addition to working inbound leads. You are a hunter first, and pipeline generation is the core measure of this role. Deal Management & Sales Process Ownership: Own large, complex deals ($500K+ annual contract value) from first contact through close, managing the timeline and multiple decision-makers across marketing, ecommerce, finance, and executive leadership. Discovery & Qualification: Ask the right questions to understand each prospect's business, priorities, and buying process well enough to qualify the opportunity and brief our strategy team. Orchestrating the Pitch: Bring in our strategy and account management teams at the right points in the sales cycle to build and deliver the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and the RFP response. Your job is to set the stage, make introductions, prep the room, and coordinate the team so the pitch lands. Pipeline Discipline & Market Awareness: Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting, and stay current on the Affiliate & Influencer Marketing space well enough to prospect credibly and know when to loop in strategy. WHAT YOU BRING Enterprise Sales Experience Demonstrated track record of closing large enterprise deals, $500K+ in annual contract value Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across marketing, ecommerce, and executive functions, without needing to own the strategic pitch personally Experience selling into marketing or ecommerce departments at large enterprise companies; experience selling into large retailers is a strong plus Hunter Mentality Proven ability to source your own opportunities through outbound prospecting: cold outreach, industry events, LinkedIn, and relationship-based selling Self-starter who doesn't rely solely on inbound leads, and is resilient and persistent about opening new doors Digital Marketing Working Knowledge General familiarity with the digital marketing space, enough to prospect credibly and hold an intelligent first conversation; deep strategic expertise isn't required, since that lives with our strategy and account management teams Affiliate / Influencer marketing knowledge is a plus, not a requirement Technical & Tools Proficiency Salesforce, required; HubSpot an advantage AI fluency, including using AI tools to work smarter in prospecting, research, and pipeline management Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Collaborative, Team-Based Selling Genuine comfort handing off the strategic narrative to internal experts, and strong ability to coordinate across strategy, account management, and delivery teams in a fully remote environment Skilled at reading a room well enough to know when to bring in an expert, and disciplined enough to prep that expert properly beforehand MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of digital marketing or marketing services sales experience Demonstrated experience closing enterprise deals of $500K+ ACV Experience selling into marketing and/or ecommerce departments at large enterprise or retail brands Proven track record of outbound pipeline generation Salesforce required; HubSpot an advantage A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work Must be based in the US, UK, Germany. Ability to travel when and where required WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE By 3 Months… You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process, and on how the handoff to strategy and account management works. You've built an active outbound pipeline, are engaging multiple enterprise prospects, and know when and how to bring in the strategy team. By 1 Year… You've closed multiple enterprise deals. Prospects consistently move smoothly from your first conversation into a strong strategy pitch, and the strategy and account management teams see you as a reliable partner who sets them up to win. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS — WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching / Pension contributions Open Paid Time Off Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Target base salary is $90-120K, with competitive, uncapped commission structure, based on location and experience Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. #LI-REMOTE *GLSDR #LI-MG1

title: Account Development Representative - Canada
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Sales Graduate at Samsara, you will be trained, both on-the-job and with formal training programs led by a high performing team of sales professionals, to develop into an Outbound Account Development Representative (ADR). Typical career path for a Sales Graduate includes 6-12 months in Sales Graduate Role, 18-24 months in an ADR role, then progression to an Account Executive position. On a daily basis, you will be responsible for timely responses to inbound inquiries, expanding our list of prospects by finding new companies to target, and ultimately contributing to the generation of new business in EMEA for Samsara. This role is remote friendly. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara. title: Senior Electrical Delivery Engineer
description: Lambda , The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. What You’ll Do Perform site walkdowns to verify installed electrical systems against approved designs, single-line diagrams, specifications, submittals, and Lambda standards. Validate equipment ratings, protection settings, phasing, grounding and bonding, terminations, labeling, redundancy, and electrical failure domains. Identify installation deficiencies, design conflicts, and operational risks; document punch-list items and drive them through closure. Review construction test results and witness factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, functional testing, and integrated systems testing. Develop and review energization plans, MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, switching procedures, and electrical safety controls. Support initial energization and troubleshoot issues involving substations, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, busway, PDUs, RPPs, and rack-level distribution. Coordinate with design engineers, engineering partners, utilities, general contractors, electrical trades, equipment manufacturers, commissioning agents, operations, and HPC deployment teams. Confirm that electrical capacity, voltage, redundancy, monitoring, and protection are ready before IT equipment is energized. Validate as-built documentation, equipment settings, test reports, commissioning records, and turnover packages before operational handoff. Capture field lessons and incorporate them into Lambda’s design standards, commissioning requirements, and site-validation playbooks. Mentor other engineers and provide senior technical leadership during high-risk energization and bring-up activities. You Have significant experience delivering, commissioning, or operating electrical systems in data centers, mission-critical facilities, utilities, or large industrial environments. Understand both medium- and low-voltage distribution, including transformers, switchgear, protective relays, generators, UPS systems, busway, grounding, and rack-level power. Can interpret single-line diagrams, equipment submittals, protection studies, relay settings, test reports, and construction documentation. Have hands-on experience with site inspections, electrical testing, energization, commissioning, or operational turnover. Understand electrical safety, lockout/tagout, energized work controls, and applicable NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, and NETA requirements. Can distinguish between cosmetic deficiencies and conditions that create material safety, reliability, or operational risk. Are comfortable making decisions in the field, escalating critical issues, and coordinating corrective work under schedule pressure. Communicate clearly with construction teams, engineers, vendors, operators, and senior stakeholders. Are willing to travel extensively and spend extended periods at active construction and commissioning sites. Hold a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience commissioning hyperscale, colocation, HPC, or AI data centers. Experience supporting first energization and initial IT-load or GPU-cluster bring-up. Familiarity with Level 1–5 commissioning, integrated systems testing, and operational-readiness processes. Experience with protective-relay testing, breaker testing, insulation-resistance testing, power-quality analysis, or infrared inspections. Experience using tools such as ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, Procore, Bluebeam, or commissioning-management platforms. Experience investigating electrical failures and leading root-cause analysis. Professional Engineer licensure, commissioning certification, or NETA-related experience. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. We build scalable, risk-based programs that evolve alongside our products and regulatory expectations. As the Compliance Manager, BSA/AML Program at Upstart, you will serve as a BSA/AML subject matter expert for Upstart Bank’s secured and unsecured lending products and support the development of new deposit products. Using a risk-based approach, you will evaluate changes to identify risks, develop controls, and measure ongoing performance of changes to ensure products and services are implemented within a strong compliance framework. How you’ll make an impact Lead the design, execution, and continuous improvement of BSA/AML, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, and sanctions screening processes for secured lending, unsecured lending, and deposit account products. Serve as a BSA/AML Compliance advisor for deposit product initiatives, partnering with Product, Legal, Operations, Engineering, and Enterprise Risk throughout product development and implementation. Develop and manage BSA/AML compliance initiatives, including new deposit product launches, regulatory enhancements, and control improvements. Administer ongoing customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence programs for deposit accounts in alignment with Upstart's Customer Identification Program (CIP), Red Flags Program, and BSA/AML compliance procedures. Evaluate relevant risks and typologies to develop appropriate transaction monitoring rules and efficient investigations processes Monitor evolving regulatory requirements, including FinCEN guidance, OFAC sanctions, and FFIEC BSA/AML examination expectations, to translate regulatory changes into scalable business processes and controls. Develop key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and management reporting that provide actionable insights into BSA/AML program effectiveness. Translate regulatory requirements and risk trends into clear recommendations for business stakeholders and senior leadership. Drive remediation efforts for examination, audit, monitoring, and testing findings while strengthening the overall BSA/AML compliance control environment. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of experience in BSA/AML compliance, financial crimes compliance, or a related Risk or Compliance role within a bank or other regulated financial institution. Experience implementing and managing customer onboarding processes including identity verification, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring processes. Working knowledge of regulatory requirements, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and Customer Due Diligence Rule, and BSA/AML risks associated with deposit products Experience developing and delivering AML risk assessments, KRIs/KPIs, and management reporting while leading cross-functional compliance initiatives. Strong organizational, analytical, communication skills. Ability to identify gaps in policies and procedures and drive resolution and closure Experience in audit and exam readiness, including evidence gathering, testing and monitoring, addressing findings, responding to requests. Preferred Qualifications Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Certified AML and Fraud Professional (CAFP), or equivalent certification. Experience implementing and optimizing an AML system, including data integration, rules configuration, testing, and validation. Experience supporting deposit products, including high-yield savings accounts, certificates of deposit, brokered deposits, or similar banking products. title: Technical Product Manager - AI & Data Analytics
description: We aren’t just looking for someone to manage a backlog; we’re looking for the founding architect of our customer-facing data and AI strategy. As a Technical Product Manager (Data & AI) , you will sit at the high-impact intersection of cutting-edge Data Science, modern Engineering, and customer-facing value. This is a highly visible, strategic role where you’ll partner directly with executive-level clients to co-develop the predictive models, analytical features, and SaaS data products that will define our industry. If you want to move away from internal tooling and actually ship AI/ML features that drive massive, quantifiable ARR, this is your playground. This job is remote in the US Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not currently or in the future provide sponsorship for employment visa status. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Shape the AI & Data Vision Own the Predictive Roadmap: Drive the vision and strategy for our external AI/ML models, advanced analytics features, and data products. Co-Innovate with Clients: Embed deeply with strategic customers and design partners to validate ideas, uncover raw user needs, and co-develop next-gen features. Tell the Story of Data: Partner with UX and Data Science to turn complex backend algorithms into beautiful, intuitive data visualizations and high-impact product demos. Execute & Ship with Impact Translate Complexity: Act as the ultimate bridge. Translate messy customer business problems into precise technical specs, transformation logic, and data requirements for our engineers and data scientists. Own the GTM: Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to launch features that aren't just technically impressive, but actually move the needle on SaaS metrics (Adoption, Retention, ARR expansion). Hypothesize & Validate: Use your analytical skills to dive into data assets, validate assumptions, and prove (or disprove) product hypotheses before writing code. What You’ll Bring to the Table 3+ years of relevant experience across Product Management, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering. Strong Business & Product Acumen: The ability to look at a complex technical feature and immediately see how it connects to customer ROI. SQL Fluency: You are comfortable writing joins and aggregations to explore data yourself. (We care about your analytical problem-solving, not whether you memorized advanced syntax). Data Visualization Chops: Experience with a modern BI platform (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, Looker) and a strong sense of how to present data clearly. The "Translator" Superpower: Elite communication skills. You can pitch a vision to an executive client, align a sales team, and debate data modeling with an engineer. WHO YOU ARE: Great product minds don’t all follow the same blueprint. You likely fall into one of these buckets: The Seasoned Data PM: You already build data products but want a more visible, customer-facing role where you can co-develop directly with clients on a modern stack. The Data-Obsessed SaaS PM: You manage a standard SaaS product, but you secretly spend all your time in SQL, building dashboards, and lurking in the analytics team's Slack channels. You're ready to make Data/AI your full-time focus. The Product-Minded Analyst: You're a Senior Data Analyst or BI Developer who doesn't just answer "what happened?" but actively tells stakeholders "what's next." You’ve been "unofficially" product-managing your work for a while and are ready to make it official. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 3+ years of relevant experience across Product Management, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering. Strong Business & Product Acumen: The ability to look at a complex technical feature and immediately see how it connects to customer ROI. SQL Fluency: You are comfortable writing joins and aggregations to explore data yourself. (We care about your analytical problem-solving, not whether you memorized advanced syntax). Data Visualization Chops: Experience with a modern BI platform (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, Looker) and a strong sense of how to present data clearly. The "Translator" Superpower: Elite communication skills. You can pitch a vision to an executive client, align a sales team, and debate data modeling with an engineer. WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME: Our Stack: Experience with (or a burning desire to learn) our modern data stack: Snowflake, DBT, Fivetran, and Sigma. Industry Context: Experience in complex B2B SaaS verticals—especially physical operations like Field Services (logistics, routing, dispatch) or Building Services—is a massive plus. These industries are sitting on massive, unoptimized datasets ripe for AI disruption. Coding Lite: Familiarity with Python or R for lightweight data analysis. AI/ML Exposure: Experience working around the machine learning lifecycle or productionized models. title: Sales Enablement Program Manager
description: About the Role WorkWave is looking for a Sales Enablement Program Manager to help turn Sales Enablement priorities into organized, scalable, and well-executed programs for our growing sales organization. Reporting to the Director of Sales Enablement, this role will serve as the program management and execution engine for the Sales Enablement function. The Program Manager will have significant responsibility for seller onboarding while also supporting ongoing training, Skill-Ups, Sales Plays, GTM and product launches, Sales Kickoff, manager enablement, and other strategic programs. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who loves making things happen. The right person can take an initiative from idea to execution, create structure around it, coordinate multiple stakeholders, facilitate when needed, keep timelines moving, and ensure programs don't end when the meeting does. As WorkWave continues to build its Sales Enablement function, this person will help establish the processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to scale. Primary Responsibilities Enablement Program Management & Execution Manage priority Sales Enablement programs from planning through execution, reinforcement, measurement, and follow-up. Translate Enablement priorities into clear project plans, timelines, milestones, owners, communications, and deliverables. Maintain visibility across active Enablement programs, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies. Coordinate across Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and other subject matter experts. Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, dependencies, capacity constraints, and execution risks. Establish repeatable processes, templates, and operating rhythms that allow Enablement programs to scale. Ensure programs move from idea to execution with clear ownership and follow-through. Seller Onboarding & Ramp Serve as the primary program owner for seller onboarding execution. Coordinate onboarding schedules, communications, facilitators, SMEs, learning activities, and stakeholder participation. Create a consistent onboarding experience that can flex based on role, segment, product, region, and hiring volume. Partner with Sales Managers to establish clear expectations before, during, and following formal onboarding. Facilitate onboarding sessions where appropriate. Partner with the Senior Manager, Sales Enablement on Highspot learning paths, curriculum, content, and certifications. Track onboarding participation, completion, feedback, certifications, and agreed-upon ramp milestones. Identify opportunities to continuously improve the onboarding and ramp experience. Ensure onboarding remains organized and effective regardless of cohort size or hiring cadence. Training, Skill-Ups & Reinforcement Program-manage recurring Skill-Ups and other seller development initiatives. Coordinate SMEs, speakers, schedules, invitations, materials, recordings, attendance, communications, and follow-up. Facilitate selected training and Enablement sessions. Build reinforcement and follow-through into Enablement programs rather than treating training as a one-time event. Partner with Sales Managers to help translate learning into consistent seller behaviors. Coordinate manager enablement and reinforcement activities as needed. GTM Launch & Sales Play Execution Operationalize GTM and product launch enablement plans established by the Director of Sales Enablement. Coordinate audiences, timelines, training sessions, facilitators, communications, dependencies, materials, and follow-up. Partner with the Senior Manager, Sales Enablement to ensure required content, learning resources, and supporting materials are available within Highspot. Program-manage Sales Play activation, including seller communications, training, coordination, reinforcement, and follow-up. Maintain visibility into upcoming launches and Enablement requirements to support effective capacity planning. Ensure approved GTM initiatives are translated into organized, actionable seller experiences. Enablement Operations & Communications Maintain the Enablement calendar across onboarding, Skill-Ups, GTM launches, Sales Plays, strategic events, and other programs. Coordinate Weekly Wave production and stakeholder inputs in partnership with the broader Enablement team. Own operational details including scheduling, invitations, facilitator coordination, attendance, recordings, communications, action items, and follow-up. Represent Enablement in cross-functional meetings when appropriate and capture relevant decisions, dependencies, risks, and next steps. Help establish and maintain an effective intake and prioritization process for incoming Enablement requests. Provide additional coverage for early-morning and global Enablement programs as needed. Identify opportunities to streamline or automate recurring Enablement processes. Sales Kickoff & Strategic Events Serve as a key program management resource for Sales Kickoff and other major Sales Enablement events. Maintain project plans, timelines, owners, dependencies, and deliverables. Coordinate speakers, sessions, materials, communications, rehearsals, logistics, recordings, and follow-up. Partner with the Director of Sales Enablement on execution of the overall SKO strategy and seller experience. Help ensure strategic events translate into continued learning and reinforcement after the event. Program Measurement & Continuous Improvement Track participation, completion, feedback, and other agreed-upon program metrics. Partner with the Director of Sales Enablement and RevOps to improve visibility into onboarding, ramp, program adoption, and effectiveness. Conduct post-program retrospectives and identify opportunities to improve future execution. Use seller and manager feedback to continuously improve the Enablement experience. Maintain clear visibility into program status, outcomes, and next steps. What Success Looks Like Enablement programs consistently have clear plans, owners, timelines, and follow-through. Seller onboarding is organized, repeatable, measurable, and scalable. Cross-functional stakeholders know what is expected of them and when. Training and Enablement programs are executed consistently and reinforced after launch. GTM launches and Sales Plays move efficiently from strategy into seller execution. SKO and strategic events are well organized and supported by strong project management. Enablement has greater visibility into program participation, completion, and effectiveness. The Enablement team spends less time chasing logistics and more time focused on improving seller performance. Programs reliably move from idea to execution. Experience & Skills Experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Programs, Learning & Development, Program Management, Sales Operations, or a related function. Strong program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously. Experience coordinating seller onboarding, training, or learning programs. Exceptional organization, follow-through, and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable facilitating live sessions with sellers, managers, and business leaders. Ability to coordinate effectively across Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners. Ability to take a loosely defined objective and turn it into a clear, executable plan. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built and priorities may evolve. Experience with Highspot or another sales enablement/LMS platform is a plus. Experience supporting distributed or global sales teams is a plus. Location & Working Style This is a remote role. Eastern or Central time zone is strongly preferred due to the global nature of WorkWave's sales organization and the need for coverage of early-morning meetings, onboarding sessions, and Enablement programs. The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable working independently, and energized by bringing organization and consistency to a growing function. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: ABOUT THE TEAM At Mural , we're changing how teams collaborate, think, and make decisions together. Growth Marketing sits inside Product and owns how people discover Mural and decide to start. Paid is a core acquisition engine for the business, working across both our self-serve and sales-assisted motions. You will own it end to end and work closely with partners across Product, Marketing, and Sales to turn demand into teams that rely on Mural. YOUR MISSION You will own Mural's paid marketing end to end: the channels, the budget, and the results. Paid plays a role across the full funnel and supports the different ways Mural grows, from building early awareness to reaching people when they are ready to act. You will bring these efforts together into one connected program, lean on experimentation and measurement to learn what works, and help turn marketing investment into durable growth. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own strategy, budget, execution, and reporting for paid across search, paid social, and video and display, running it as one connected program across the full funnel. You will own Mural’s paid marketing end to end, with a focus on generating efficient growth across self-serve acquisition and sales-assisted demand. Success will be measured by the quality and volume of activated users, qualified pipeline, and revenue generated from paid investment. Build and run a continuous experimentation program across audiences, creative, landing pages, and offers. Lead agency and vendor partners to execute and scale the program. Partner with our Data team on attribution and measurement to connect paid spend to real outcomes. Partner across Marketing and Web on messaging and the post-click experience. Set performance targets and expand the program into new regions and languages, including EMEA and APAC. Support account-based and demand generation programs in close partnership with the Sales and RevOps teams. Use AI in your daily workflow to move faster across keyword, creative, analysis, and reporting work, with a point of view on where AI is changing paid marketing. WHAT YOU'LL BRING 5+ years of hands-on B2B digital and performance marketing, owning paid search, paid social, and video or display with real budget responsibility. A full funnel operator comfortable across both self-serve growth and sales-assisted demand. You have owned awareness and demand creation, not only bottom funnel capture, and can show how top of funnel and account-based work pay off downstream. You design and read clean tests across audiences, creative, and landing pages, and you know what to do with an inconclusive result. Comfort living in the performance data, with hands-on fluency in SQL, product analytics, and BI tools. A real point of view on measurement. You know where last-click falls short and have used holdouts, incrementally, or media mix testing to judge channels that do not attribute cleanly. Experience running paid inside a self-serve or freemium model, with a feel for how acquisition connects to activation and retention. A self-starter who is motivated and scrappy, thinks through problems, and brings innovative solutions in a high-growth environment. Equal Opportunity We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Strategic Relationship Management: Strong executive presence with experience presenting to C-suite and VP level decision makers during Executive Business Reviews. Analytical & Goal Oriented: Ability to define, track, and present business KPIs and quantifiable business outcomes. Whether you work remotely or in the office, you’ll join a inclusive, curious team dedicated to building best-in-class software. title: Fulfillment Specialist (Canada)
description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. Fulfillment Specialist About the Role (This is a position in Toronto Canada not remote) Dandy is looking for a Fulfillment Specialist to support daily fulfillment operations in Toronto Canada. You’ll help ensure dental kits, accessories, consumables, and replacement orders are prepared, inspected, fulfilled, and shipped accurately and on time while maintaining ready-to-ship inventory. You’ll work across prep, live fulfillment, receiving, inventory, quality control, asset recovery, repair routing, and shipping. The role is hands-on and detail-oriented: you’ll follow configuration-specific SOPs, identify issues before they reach a customer, communicate clearly across functional areas, and surface practical ideas that make the operation safer, faster, or more accurate. You’ll be successful in this role if you take ownership of your work, learn new processes quickly, respond well to coaching, and consistently balance speed with quality and safety in a fast-paced fulfillment environment. What You'll Do Fulfillment & Shipping: Pick, pack, ship, and close Vision and Trios outbound kits to standard cycle times; execute ITX and Conversion replacement orders; pick and ship accessory and consumable orders day-of. Quality & Prep: Inspect every outbound kit against the configuration-specific SOP; execute Computer QC and imaging during prep; QC returned scanners and route them appropriately. Asset Recovery: Inspect returned assets and determine the appropriate path. Execute Wrap Fix on returned scanners and laptops. Inventory & Receiving: Receive inbound POs and route inventory to the correct locations; restock pick locations to maintain Live Fulfillment readiness; conduct routine cycle counts and execute inventory adjustments; flag discrepancies to a Senior or Lead. Operations & Improvement: Identify fulfillment inefficiencies and surface ideas that improve safety, speed, or accuracy. Participate in initiatives and pilots and provide input on SOP updates based on floor observations. Communication & Systems: Communicate clearly across functional areas, especially between prep and live fulfillment workflows. Use NetSuite, Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, RF Smart, and Slack to execute and document daily tasks. What We're Looking For Ability to work full-time in the office Monday–Friday. 2+ years of experience in distribution, warehousing, fulfillment, manufacturing, or operations. Experience solving operational problems, exercising good judgment, and communicating effectively across a diverse team. Strong personal accountability, organization, attention to detail, and willingness to take ownership of tasks. title: Corporate Sales Manager (Enterprise, NZ)
description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . Corporate Sales Manager (Enterprise Sales) - New Zealand We are searching for a driven and skillful sales hunter to grow Halter’s corporate market segment across existing and new accounts in New Zealand. We are looking for someone with X-factor across the sales cycle, a hunter at heart, and deep experience driving complex sales cycles. You will be contributing to the growth of Halter across the largest farming businesses in New Zealand, building relationships with key stakeholders, and playing a key role in the success and growth of existing corporate entities. You’ll be an expert at building trusting relationships, identifying opportunities within a farming system, and navigating key stakeholders in order to build and progress a pipeline of opportunities. You will know how to build urgency and navigate the constraints of enterprise clients. You’ll thrive in high-pressure environments, using initiative to make results happen, often against the odds. You might find yourself in a boardroom negotiating a million-dollar contract one day, reporting key KPI’s to leadership/exec’s the next day, and working closely with our Account Managers of existing clients to ensure value is being delivered across the business. You’ll masterfully navigate corporate layers, adjusting your communication at each level accordingly, to convey the right context and value to all parties. This isn’t a typical role. You’ll be playing a critical role in Halter’s growth into the enterprise market segment. Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster of the world's fastest growing, and most transformational AgTech company, you will be making a real-world impact. You will change how large scale farm entities can operate, unlocking a more productive, resilient and sustainable farming system. You will build relationships across the most influential farming leaders in New Zealand, while working closely with senior leaders within Halter. Up for the challenge? Let’s talk. This role is to be based in New Zealand. Frequent travel is required as part of the position. What your day could look like Enterprise Sales Meetings: You’ll spend your days engaging with the largest farming operations in New Zealand. These businesses often span multiple business units, decision-makers, and territories, and you’ll need to understand their structure, surface critical challenges, and map Halter’s value across the full enterprise. You’ll lead complex sales cycles from end-to-end, guiding stakeholders through discovery, evaluation, and procurement, and navigating multi-layered negotiations all the way through to signed agreements and successful rollouts. Enterprise Prospecting: An active rolling pipeline is core to this role. You’ll be actively developing relationships from farm to board unlocking enterprise opportunities through a mix of strategies: identifying and approaching high-value leaders/stakeholders, activating your network, driving event engagement, and leading outbound efforts. You’ll be expected to own this work and build repeatable systems to fuel a consistent, high-value pipeline. Strategic Account Management & Expansion: Once a customer is onboard, you won’t hand them off — you’ll go deeper. You’ll work across divisions, geographies, and leadership levels to strengthen relationships, identify new value levers, and drive strategic expansions. You'll work closely with Halter Account Managers to unlock organisation-wide adoption and ensure our most important customers get the most out of Halter. Enterprise Networking & Influence: You're not just selling, you're becoming known. In this role, you'll be expected to build meaningful relationships with board members, operational leaders, and key influencers across each account. You’ll be visible in the community and intentional in how you grow your influence and personal brand in-market. Cross-functional Execution: You’ll be the voice of your enterprise customers within Halter. You’ll partner closely with the Head of Corporate, product, and support teams to align on strategic goals, drive innovation that meets customer needs to ensure best-in-class results for your accounts. Forecasting & Strategy: Work with the Head of Corporate to provide accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts. You’ll bring precision to your pipeline and clarity to your new business and existing business engagement strategy, making it easier for Halter to plan, invest, and grow. Growth Projects: You’ll help shape what great looks like. This role isn’t just about delivering numbers — it’s about building scalable systems and strategies that allow us to serve more enterprise customers, more effectively, as Halter scales. You'll collaborate on playbook development, sales process optimisation, and commercial experimentation. Who are we looking for A true enterprise sales hunter – someone who thrives on complexity, sees opportunity in ambiguity, and knows how to unlock deals in high-stakes, multi-stakeholder environments. Proven experience selling into enterprise or large corporate customers, ideally in agriculture or related systems. You’ve run long sales cycles, influenced at the board level, and expanded accounts over time. Deep industry understanding – ideally, you’ve worked in or around large-scale farming systems, and you understand the language, needs, and pace of this world. A phenomenal attitude, strong ownership, and an unshakable focus on the customer. You bring energy to the room, take responsibility, and don’t let obstacles slow you down. Comfort with autonomy, ambiguity, and pace – we’re growing fast, and you’ll need to move quickly, make great calls, and adjust as we scale. A growth mindset and relentless drive to learn, improve, and lead. This is a chance to grow your career alongside a high-performing, high-impact team. Our Benefits: Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being. We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family. Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth. Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave. Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan. Join our team Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit! If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch! Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram . Why our team loves working at Halter: Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations. Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems. You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund. This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
description: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them. These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs: They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts. They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part. They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines. They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs. They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session. What you'll do Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance. How we build Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level. Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change. Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters. Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice. Recent work Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked. A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half. Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice. Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66. A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people. What we look for You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working. You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security. You build the eval before you trust the result. You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°. Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics. Stack Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry Pay UK £80k–£125k · US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity.
